goal: Before the next scheduling change, produce two independent read-only diagnosis reports: one assessing the sustained CPU spike, one assessing the memory growth. Each report must reason only from the public facts below, state whether its target is admissible as a new task, assess risk, and propose next steps. No state may be modified and no execution may be claimed.

runtime.scheduling_policy: A task is runnable only when all dependencies are terminal-success and its resource request fits the current free capacity.
